name: Shure MV7+
author: Joel Gaff, Jr.
description: Every setting of a Shure MV7+ from the bar: mute, gain and Auto Level, how loud you hear yourself and the computer in the mic's headphone jack, high-pass, compressor, limiter, denoiser, popper stopper, tone, reverb, LEDs, presets, device name and factory reset. Driven by shurectl --follow (the joelgaff/shurectl fork, built by install.sh).

barWidget.description: Mute, gain, headphone mix, processing, reverb, LEDs and presets of a Shure MV7+ (needs the joelgaff/shurectl fork; run install.sh)

schema.label: shurectl binary
schema.description: Path to a shurectl that has --follow (empty: ~/.local/bin/shurectl, where install.sh puts it).

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the mic is read so its own mute button and MOTIV app changes show up.

schema.label: Scroll step (%)
schema.description: How much scrolling on the bar icon changes how loud you hear yourself.
